# Rise Science

> > Rise Science provides evidence-based sleep science guidance and the RISE app to optimize circadian rhythm, sleep tracking, and energy management through personalized recommendations.

Rise Science combines sleep medicine expertise with sleep tracking technology to help users understand their circadian rhythm, sleep debt, and energy patterns. The site features content from sleep physicians and clinicians covering sleep optimization, troubleshooting common sleep issues, and improving overall health through better sleep.

## Key Topics

- circadian rhythm
- sleep tracking
- sleep debt
- RISE app
- sleep medicine
- sleep quality
- sleep hygiene
- energy optimization
- sleep schedule
- blue light
- sleep apnea
- melatonin
- naps
- relaxation techniques
- sleep performance

## Sleep Tracking & Circadian Rhythm

- [Circadian Rhythm Test: This App Can Predict It](https://www.risescience.com/blog/circadian-rhythm-test): Guide to finding circadian rhythm using RISE sleep tracking app
- [How Much Sleep Debt is Good vs Bad?](https://www.risescience.com/insights/the-most-important-sleep-data-to-track): Guide to healthy sleep debt levels and sleep tracking metrics
- [RISE App vs. Sleep Cycle: Which Sleep Tracking App to Choose](https://www.risescience.com/blog/rise-app-vs-sleep-cycle): Comparison of RISE app and Sleep Cycle sleep tracking features
- [RiseScience.com current](https://www.risescience.com/insights-es/moving-your-sleep-and-energy-schedule): Guide to adjusting sleep schedule and circadian rhythm optimization

## Sleep Optimization & Improvement

- [Waking Up Early? 9 Possible Reasons Why and How to Fix Them](https://www.risescience.com/blog/waking-up-early): Troubleshooting guide for early waking causes and solutions
- [Wired at Bedtime? Try These Relaxation Techniques for Sleep](https://www.risescience.com/blog/relaxation-techniques-for-sleep): Guide to science-backed relaxation exercises for better sleep
- [Naps](https://www.risescience.com/insights/naps): Guide to optimal nap timing and duration for energy management
- [Sleep and Weight Loss: What's the Connection?](https://www.risescience.com/blog/sleep-and-weight-loss): Article on sleep's role in weight loss and circadian rhythm alignment
- [Yoga Nidra: Can It Help You Sleep? Can It Replace Sleep?](https://www.risescience.com/blog/yoga-nidra): Explanation of yoga nidra benefits and limitations for sleep

## Sleep Environment & Habits

- [Should You Avoid Screens Before Bed? A Sleep Doctor's Take](https://www.risescience.com/blog/screens-before-bed): Sleep doctor advice on screen time and blue-light impact on sleep
- [Do Blue-Light Glasses Work for Sleep? Here's the Science](https://www.risescience.com/blog/do-blue-light-glasses-work): Scientific review of blue-light glasses effectiveness for sleep
- [Why Does My Throat Hurt When I Wake Up? 9 Possible Triggers](https://www.risescience.com/blog/why-does-my-throat-hurt-when-i-wake-up): Article on morning throat pain causes and sleep quality improvement
